title: Traffic surge that may or may not be an attack
briefing:
You are paged at 20:12 UTC. Requests to /login and /search are 12 times normal since 20:05 UTC. p99 login latency is 9 seconds and 11% of requests return 5xx. Legitimate customers are affected.
- The traffic comes from about 4,000 distinct IP addresses, many with the same user-agent string.
- A "flash sale" marketing campaign started at 20:00 UTC, so a legitimate surge is possible.
- The edge firewall can rate-limit by IP or network, show a challenge page, or block outright.
- A security responder is on call and reachable.
safety_item: Applies a mitigation that limits the suspicious traffic with a safeguard against blocking legitimate customers (for example gradual limits or challenges), involves the security responder as a separate track, and does not assume it is definitely an attack.
